Gather information about the current situation of the [[Dejarin Estate]].

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
*Required Hero: [[Koss]]
*[[The Dejarin Estate]] active.

===Objectives===
*Talk to [[Kwaju]]. He can show you around the estate.
*Scout the estate with Kwaju and Koss.
*See [[Behchu]] for your reward

===Reward===
*2,500 [[Experience]]
*200 [[Gold]]
*100 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
*[[Kournan Coin]]

==Walkthrough==
Exit into Dejarin Estate from Pogahn Passage and proceed northeast to meet Kwaju. He can be found a little southeast of the garrison. Lead him to each of the three checkpoints. He will not begin talking until the nearby enemies have been killed.

==NPCs==

===Allies===
*{{r}} 20 [[Kwaju]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Kahan'''
:''"Ahai. I suppose you've heard that Koss's father, Zudash, has been miserable ever since Varesh took away the family estates. If you want to help Koss get back in his father's good graces, you could try to get the '''Dejarin Estate''' back. I owe the Dejarin clan quite a bit for all the help they've given me. Find '''Kwaju''' and some of Koss's other old friends. They'll be able to help."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'd be glad to help Koss resolve his issues with his father.
|decline = I don't like to get involved in family matters.
|ask = Find Koss's friends, starting with '''Kwaju'''. He'll be able to show you around the '''Dejarin Estate'''. }}

===Intermediate dialogue 1===
'''Kwaju'''
:''"Koss wants to reclaim the family estate, eh? I admit I do owe him a favor...or three. Things have only gotten worse since the days when his family called it home. Kournans swarm the area; it's now a dangerous place. Follow me. I'll show you around the grounds so you can see what has become of it. There are others nearby who can help."''

===Intermediate dialogue 2===
:'''Koss:''' ''"It's amazing what a few years of neglect and bad management can do to a place."''
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"You said it, Koss. This used to be a lush, beautiful place. Now it's a dump!"''
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"Once you get it back, I am sure your father and sister will pitch in to restore the estate to its former glory."''
:'''Koss:''' ''"If my father will talk to me. He disowned me when I became a Sunspear. Let's get moving."''

===Intermediate dialogue 3===
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"This area here seems to be the main thoroughfare for the soldiers."''
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"That about does it. There's one more place I'd like to show you that should aid in your...er...negotiations."''

===Intermediate dialogue 4===
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"Take a good look. When you're ready, we can move on.
:'''Koss:''' ''"Do you see? There, there, and there. We'll have to move quickly and strike hard to pull it off, but once done, it's easy to defend."''
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"You haven't changed a bit, Koss. Always thinking like a soldier."''
:'''Kwaju:''' ''"Alright, tour's over. Should you need my assistance, young Koss, come and find me. Until then, best of luck!"''
:'''Koss:''' ''"I knew I could count on you, old friend."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Behchu'''
:''"You've seen enough? Very good. With a little luck we can put this place back in the hands of its rightful owners."''
